clues: This town lies in the hills of west Mexico. A road and rail line link it with Guadalajara.
The air here is hot and damp. Rain falls in one long season, from March to July each year.
In 2023, Mexico gave this town a new title. It was named a Pueblo Mágico for its culture and past.
Gold and clay art were dug up at an old site near town. The finds now sit in the town museum.
An old Toltec temple stands just east of town. It is the top old site in the north west of Mexico, built for Quetzalcoatl.
